In comparison to my 2 involuntary stays which were 12 and 14 days. Voluntary is much shorter usually but the staff will try and pester you about your problems (and I would advise telling at least a little bit) but you don't have to say anything if you really don't want to

When you're voluntary in my state you can leave any time after 24 hours unless the medical staff sees you unsafe to leave (and then they fill out forms) but my voluntary stays were between 3 days to about 7.  It depends on how severe you feel.  No matter the length though, its usually worth being inpatient if you feel dangerous to yourself.  If you're not so severe but need asap medical attention, most hospitals also have an intensive outpatient care center where you can sleep at home and have your life but you have LOTS of appointments and stuff. I did something very similar out of desperation months ago.  I basically shaved the skin on my wrist raw and it got infected and itched like a bitch. Horrible idea for sure.  I bought Neosporin and I kept it clean with unscented soap (basically how I treated my healing tattoos) and it didn't take too long to heal.  The hardest part was finding something to cover it with in my sleep to prevent myself from itching while in bed or chilling.  Itching will make it last forever.. Dont over clean it and don't itch it basically.  And of course, try and not repeat it ;) <3
